==Format==
* '''Group Stage:''' 
** Teams are divided into two (2) groups of six (6) teams 
** Double Round Robin, {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 4th place of each group''}} advances to the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''5th and 6th place''}} are eliminated.
* '''Playoffs:'''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
